ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, point A is the starting point where two gardens are connected, located at the lower-right corner of the square garden on the left and also at the upper-left corner of the rectangular garden on the right. The side length of the square garden on the left is marked as 5 m, so all four sides are 5 m. The long side of the rectangular garden on the right is marked as 10 m, and the short side is marked as 5 m. The arrows in the figure show two people starting from point A and each going along the boundary of their own garden. Reasoning: The distance Ahmed walks for one lap around the square is 4×5=20 m. The distance Sara walks for one lap around the rectangle is 2×(10+5)=30 m. The two people have the same speed. To meet for the first time by returning to point A at the same time, the total distance walked needs to be a multiple of both 20 and 30. The least common multiple of 20 and 30 is 60 m. Therefore the number of laps Ahmed needs to walk is 60÷20=3.
